```{r setup, include=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```


``` {r Data load, message = FALSE}

# Low risk trials
TBLData <- read.csv("LowRiskTBL2025.csv")
library(metafor) # main package for analysis

```



``` {r Setup}

#Row index of obstetrics trials
obstetrics_index <- TBLData$covar.Surg == "Obstetrics"

#Delete obstetrics trials
bloodLossData <- TBLData[!obstetrics_index, ]

#Row index of the trials that have complete blood loss data
complete_index <- !is.na(bloodLossData$Mean.1) & !is.na(bloodLossData$Mean.2) &
  !is.na(bloodLossData$SD.1) & !is.na(bloodLossData$SD.2) &
  !is.na(bloodLossData$N.1) & !is.na(bloodLossData$N.2)

#Delete rows without complete blood loss data
bloodLossData <- bloodLossData[complete_index, ]

#Effect size
bloodLossData[, c("log_mean_ratio", "variance")] <- 
  metafor::escalc(measure = "ROM",
                  m1i = bloodLossData$Mean.2,
                  m2i = bloodLossData$Mean.1,
                  sd1i = bloodLossData$SD.2,
                  sd2i = bloodLossData$SD.1,
                  n1i = bloodLossData$N.2,
                  n2i = bloodLossData$N.1)[c("yi", "vi")]

# Only trials where control arm blood loss < 500ml

# bloodLossData <- bloodLossData[bloodLossData$Mean.1 < 500,]

```

# Main analysis

## Scatterplot

``` {r Scatterplot}

#Scatterplot of ratio of means in blood loss vs blood loss in placebo arm
y_axis_marks <- seq(from = -0.8, to = 0.2, by = 0.2)
plot(x = bloodLossData$Mean.1,
     y = bloodLossData$log_mean_ratio,
     xlab = "Blood loss in placebo arm (ml)",
     xlim = c(0, 1200),
     ylab = "Ratio of means in blood loss (ml)",
     ylim = c(-0.8, 0.2),
     main = "Ratio of means in blood loss vs blood loss in placebo arm",
     yaxt = "n")
axis(side = 2, at = y_axis_marks, labels = round(exp(y_axis_marks), digits = 1))
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
```


## Model results

```{r Models}

#Fixed effects
fixedTBL <- metafor::rma(yi = log_mean_ratio, vi = variance, data = bloodLossData, method = "FE")
paste("Fixed effects model results")
summary(fixedTBL)

#Random effects
randomTBL <- metafor::rma(yi = log_mean_ratio, vi = variance, data = bloodLossData)
paste("Random effects model results")
summary(randomTBL)
```


## Forest plot

``` {r Forest plot, fig.height = 10, fig.width = 8}

bloodLossData$Mean.1 <- round(bloodLossData$Mean.1, digits = 1)
bloodLossData$Mean.2 <- round(bloodLossData$Mean.2, digits = 1)
bloodLossData$SD.1 <- round(bloodLossData$SD.1, digits = 1)
bloodLossData$SD.2 <- round(bloodLossData$SD.2, digits = 1)

n_trials <- length(bloodLossData$Study)

forest(randomTBL,
       slab = paste(bloodLossData$Study),
       xlim = c(-7, 3),
       ylim = c(-3, n_trials + 3),
       ilab = cbind(bloodLossData$Mean.2,
                    bloodLossData$SD.2,
                    bloodLossData$N.2,
                    bloodLossData$Mean.1,
                    bloodLossData$SD.1,
                    bloodLossData$N.1),
       ilab.xpos = seq(-5, -2.5, length.out = 6),
       atransf = exp,
       addpred = TRUE,
       header = FALSE,
       cex = 0.8,
       width = 10,
       main = "Forest Plot of Total Blood Loss Meta-Analysis")
text(x = seq(-5, -2.5, length.out = 6), y = n_trials + 1.6,
     labels = c("Mean", "SD", "N", "Mean", "SD", "N"), cex = 0.8)
text(x = seq(-5, -2.5, length.out = 6)[c(2, 5)], y = n_trials + 2.5,
     labels = c("Treatment", "Control"), cex = 0.8)
text(x = -7, y = n_trials + 1.6,
     labels = "Study ID", pos = 4, cex = 0.8)
text(x = 3, y = n_trials + 1.6,
     labels = "Ratio of means [95% CI]", pos = 2, cex = 0.8)
addpoly.rma(fixedTBL, atransf = exp, addpred=TRUE)

```


## Funnel plots

``` {r}

# SurgeryCode

SurgCode <- bloodLossData$covar.Surg
SurgCode[SurgCode == "Otolaryngology (ENT)"] = 1
SurgCode[SurgCode == "Gynecology"] = 2
SurgCode[SurgCode == "Orthopaedics"] = 3
SurgCode[SurgCode == "Urology"] = 4
SurgCode[SurgCode == "Oral & Maxillofacial"] = 5
SurgCode[SurgCode == "Plastic Surgery"] = 6
SurgCode <- as.numeric(SurgCode)

# Funnel plots with and without covariate

FunnelTBL <- funnel(randomTBL, level=c(90, 95, 99), shade=c("white", "gray55", "gray75"), pch = SurgCode,
                      main = "Funnel Plot: Total Blood Loss Meta-Analysis \n (by Surgery)", refline = 0)
legend("topright", legend = unique(bloodLossData$covar.Surg), pch = seq(1,6))


# Route of administration code

bloodLossData$covar.Route[is.na(bloodLossData$covar.Route)] <- "Missing"

RouteCode <- bloodLossData$covar.Route
RouteCode[RouteCode == "Combined"] = 3
RouteCode[RouteCode == "Intramuscular"] = 4
RouteCode[RouteCode == "Oral"] = 5
RouteCode[RouteCode == "Topical/Intra-articular"] = 2
RouteCode[RouteCode == "Intravenous"] = 1
RouteCode[RouteCode == "Missing"] = 6
RouteCode <- as.numeric(RouteCode)

FunnelTBL <- funnel(randomTBL, level=c(90, 95, 99), shade=c("white", "gray55", "gray75"), pch = RouteCode,
                      main = "Funnel Plot: Total Blood Loss Meta-Analysis \n (by Route of Administration)", refline = 0)
legend("topright", legend = unique(bloodLossData$covar.Route), pch = seq(1,6))


```


# Subgroup analysis by type of surgery

## Model results

``` {r}

# Just using low risk trials

#The types of surgery
surgery_types <- sort(unique(bloodLossData$covar.Surg))

#Random effects MR
random_tbl_surg <- metafor::rma(yi = log_mean_ratio, vi = variance, mods = ~ covar.Surg, data = bloodLossData)
summary(random_tbl_surg)

#Matrix used to get the fitted values by surgery type
surgery_types_matrix <- rbind(rep(0, times = length(surgery_types) - 1), diag(1, nrow = length(surgery_types) - 1))
rownames(surgery_types_matrix) <- surgery_types

#Fitted values by surgery type
fitted_tbl_surg <- predict(random_tbl_surg, newmods = surgery_types_matrix, addx = TRUE)
```


## Subgroup plot

``` {r}

#Increase the left margin to allow the type of surgery labels to fit
par(mar = c(5.1, 12, 4.1, 2.1))
#Set up the plot area
plot(NA, NA, xlim = c(-1.2, 0.3), ylim = c(0.5, length(surgery_types) + 0.5),
     xlab = "Mean & 95% Confidence / Prediction Interval", xaxt = "n",
     ylab = "", yaxt = "n",
     main = "Ratio of means of blood loss\nby type of surgery")
#Add mean and CI for each type of surgery
for (surg in surgery_types) {
  lines(x = c(fitted_tbl_surg$pi.lb[fitted_tbl_surg$slab == surg],
              fitted_tbl_surg$pi.ub[fitted_tbl_surg$slab == surg]),
        y = rep(which(surg == surgery_types), times = 2), lty="dashed")
  lines(x = c(fitted_tbl_surg$ci.lb[fitted_tbl_surg$slab == surg],
              fitted_tbl_surg$ci.ub[fitted_tbl_surg$slab == surg]),
        y = rep(which(surg == surgery_types), times = 2), lwd=2)
  points(x = fitted_tbl_surg$pred[fitted_tbl_surg$slab == surg],
         y = which(surg == surgery_types),
         pch = 16)
}
#x-axis
x_ticks <- c(-1.2, -0.9, -0.6, -0.3, 0, 0.3)
axis(side = 1, at = x_ticks, labels = signif(exp(x_ticks), digits = 2))
#y-axis
axis(side = 2, at = 1:length(surgery_types), labels = surgery_types, las = 1)
#Reset the margins to default
par(mar = c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 2.1))

```



# Subgroup analysis by route of administration

## Model results

``` {r}

# Just using low risk trials

#The types of surgery
routes <- sort(unique(bloodLossData$covar.Route))

#Random effects MR
random_tbl_route <- metafor::rma(yi = log_mean_ratio, vi = variance, mods = ~ covar.Route, data = bloodLossData)
summary(random_tbl_route)

#Matrix used to get the fitted values by surgery type
routes_matrix <- rbind(rep(0, times = length(routes) - 1), diag(1, nrow = length(routes) - 1))
rownames(routes_matrix) <- routes

#Fitted values by surgery type
fitted_tbl_route <- predict(random_tbl_route, newmods = routes_matrix, addx = TRUE)
```


## Subgroup plot

``` {r}

#Increase the left margin to allow the route of administration labels to fit
par(mar = c(5.1, 12, 4.1, 2.1))
#Set up the plot area
plot(NA, NA, xlim = c(-1.2, 0.3), ylim = c(0.5, length(routes) + 0.5),
     xlab = "Mean & 95% Confidence / Prediction Interval", xaxt = "n",
     ylab = "", yaxt = "n",
     main = "Ratio of means of blood loss\nby route of administration")
#Add mean and CI for each type of surgery
for (surg in routes) {
  lines(x = c(fitted_tbl_route$pi.lb[fitted_tbl_route$slab == surg],
              fitted_tbl_route$pi.ub[fitted_tbl_route$slab == surg]),
        y = rep(which(surg == routes), times = 2), lty="dashed")
  lines(x = c(fitted_tbl_route$ci.lb[fitted_tbl_route$slab == surg],
              fitted_tbl_route$ci.ub[fitted_tbl_route$slab == surg]),
        y = rep(which(surg == routes), times = 2), lwd=2)
  points(x = fitted_tbl_route$pred[fitted_tbl_route$slab == surg],
         y = which(surg == routes),
         pch = 16)
}
#x-axis
x_ticks <- c(-1.2, -0.9, -0.6, -0.3, 0, 0.3)
axis(side = 1, at = x_ticks, labels = signif(exp(x_ticks), digits = 2))
#y-axis
axis(side = 2, at = 1:length(routes), labels = routes, las = 1)
#Reset the margins to default
par(mar = c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 2.1))

```
